     Bichloride of Mercury ; Corrosive Sublimate. Hg CL.

     Provings by Buchner upon himself, Forstner, Gerster, Held, Nusser and Pemerl (Allg. Zeit. für Hom., 1849) ; Robinson (B. J. of Hom., vol. 25, p. 324) ; Haight (U. S. J. of Hom., vol. 1, p. 7) ; Brewer (Med. Inv., vol. 7, p. 160) ; and Berridge (Am. J. H. M. M., vol. 8, p. 126).

     Toxicological reports are numerous ; those mentioned by Hahnemann in his Materia Medica Pura are given prominence.
